c: Dairy Cart is a destructible, akin to light sources, that can be found in
. It also functions as a special weapon.

In the stage, there are rails in predetermined locations in the tileset, where the carts can spawn on their left end. When the player deals 40 damage to a cart, it gets launched at high speed towards the other end of the rail. Any enemies that come in contact with it are dealt 100 damage.
Dairy Carts have a special interaction with the Stalker in the Dairy Plant, causing it to drop a Treasure Chest when killed by a cart and trigger
Dairy Cart can attack and defeat the otherwise intangible Stalkers in
before minute 30, causing them to drop lower quality chests.
